<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def orng(fr):
    px=[(i,j) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if fr.ascii.split('\n')[i][j]=='O']
    if not px: return None
    rs=[p[0] for p in px]; cs=[p[1] for p in px]
    return (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
def npos(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((min(rs),min(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
for k in range(3):
    r=action(['LEFT'])
    print('step',k,'changed',last_action_result.get('board_changed'),'orange',orng(current_frame),'N',npos(current_frame))
    if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'): break
</parameter>
</function>
